prompt.main_subject: An adult Asian fashion performer with a tall slender silhouette, maintaining continuity through a sweet-cool ten-second rapid outfit-change sequence.
prompt.composition_elements: The performer stays central while gestures trigger timed outfit transitions. Face-covering, hair-swinging, sleeve-sweeping, jumps, turns, and heart gestures provide the transition structure.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: No specific lighting or environment is provided. Preserve a polished sweet-cool fashion atmosphere without inventing a setting.

technical_specs.duration_pacing: Ten sequential one-second beats from 0-1s through 9-10s; use as narrative pacing, not an API duration parameter.
technical_specs.camera: Keep the performer visible during each gesture; exact shot and movement are not specified.
technical_specs.motion: Smooth action transitions and consistent performer continuity.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Use the approved adult performer reference for an adult Asian fashion performer with a tall slender silhouette. Create a sweet-cool style rapid outfit-change sequence with smooth action transitions. 0-1s: academy-inspired uniform, hands behind back, tiptoe jump, tie swinging, head tilted with eyes smiling like crescent moons. 1-2s: turn around and swing hair to cover the face, changing into a Lolita-inspired dress. 2-3s: cross arms to cover the face, changing into sportswear. 3-4s: swing a sleeve across the lens, changing into an ancient-style ru skirt. 4-5s: cover the face then separate the hands, changing into a sweet-cool spaghetti-strap dress. 5-6s: land a small jump, changing into pajamas, rubbing eyes and yawning. 6-7s: turn with the back to camera, changing into a sailor-inspired uniform, raising hands to make a heart shape and waving left and right. 7-8s: lower the head to adjust the collar then look up, changing into an idol stage outfit and raising a hand in a microphone-holding gesture. 8-9s: hug the chest then release, changing into denim, pulling the zipper and lifting the chin. 9-10s: turn around and swing the arms, changing back to the opening uniform.
